title: Moving the roadmap into work items

steps.page: Three pairs that look like one piece of work
steps.intro: Rule: Planning items may not overlap. These pairs overlap enough that the reviewer suggests merging each into one.

steps.headline: Merge #47 and #136 into one item?
steps.today:
#47 · Planning · P2 — The model list says whether a model FITS and nothing about whether it will be fast

#136 · Exploring · P2 — Model rows in the picker carry no cost or intelligence tags, so choosing means knowing the names
steps.problem: Both describe the same strip of tags on each model row in the picker: 47 is the speed tag and 136 is the cost and intelligence tags meant to sit beside it, so they need one design.
steps.proposal: Keep #47, fold #136's text into it, and remove #136. Nothing is lost: the merged item keeps both descriptions.

options.label: Merge them
pros: One item for one piece of work.
cons: They can no longer be tracked separately.

steps.headline: Seven items were moved to a different stage than their old roadmap status suggested.
steps.changed:
#25 → Exploring: Destin parked the usage-analytics gap 'as its own conversation'; nothing about what to collect has been decided.

#61 → Exploring: Agents and Automations waits on a ruling about its basic building block that is 'captured, not designed', so its shape is still open.

#136 → Exploring: The model-row tags are explicitly undesigned: where the numbers come from and whether they fit a row are open questions.

#55 → Planning: The sign-in fix is already designed (device-flow to loopback proof); what remains is building and rolling it out.

#58 → Planning: Destin agreed the built-in 'Your Assistant' project as a 1.3.1 blocker with a clear shape; only the name is unsettled.

#31 → Planning: The Play listing steps are concrete and unblocked (account, upload, forms); it is low priority, not undecided.

#20 → Planning: Nobody is building it: the feature flow is finished and waiting for the first small UI feature to trial it on.
steps.notice: Exploring = not settled yet. Planning = agreed, ready to plan the build.

steps.headline: Four items now say what has to exist before them.
steps.changed:
#117 needs #115: A phone browser can only use the microphone on an encrypted connection, which 115 builds.

#86 needs #61: Item (f), sending automation results to Telegram, Discord or email, says it waits until Agents and Automations exists.

#61 needs #63: Agents and Automations is blocked on Destin's 'Assistants made of Duties' ruling, which is parked as 63(l).

#64 needs #61: Mesh and Cloud decide where scheduled duties and automations run, so the automations themselves must exist first.
steps.notice: Plus 19 pairs that only touch now carry a "See also" note on each, so a chat working on one sees the other.
